value.description:
As part of its enforcement efforts, OFAC publishes a list of individuals and
companies owned or controlled by, or acting for or on behalf of, targeted
countries. It also lists individuals, groups, and entities, such as terrorists
and narcotics traffickers designated under programs that are not country-specific.
Collectively, such individuals and companies are called "Specially Designated
Nationals" or "SDNs." Their assets are blocked and U.S. persons are generally
prohibited from dealing with them.

publisher.description: OFAC is a divison of the United States Department of the Treasury that administers and enforces economic and trade sanctions based on US foreign policy and national security goals against targeted foreign countries and regimes, terrorists, international narcotics traffickers, those engaged in activities related to the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction, and other threats to the national security, foreign policy or economy of the United​ States.

post.description: Start here to find an entity_id for get_entity, or to browse a dataset or program with filters only (no q).

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

continuation.description: Value of next_continuation from a previous page (the site's offset). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

countries.description: Lower-case country codes as OpenSanctions uses them, including historic/territory codes (ru, ua, suhh, ua-cri, eu).

datasets.description: Restrict to entities present in these dataset names (us_ofac_sdn, eu_fsf, wikidata, ...).

program_id.description: Sanctions program code (EU-UKR, US-IRAN, GB-RUS, ...); sent as filter=properties.programId:<id>. Pattern: ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{1,40}$.

q.description: Free-text name query. Optional when at least one filter is given.

schema.description: FollowTheMoney schema name: Person, Company, Organization, LegalEntity, PublicBody, Vessel, Airplane, Address, CryptoWallet, Security. Pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Za-z]{2,40}$.

scope.description: Dataset or collection to search within (default: the site's 'default' collection). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9_]{2,80}$.

topics.description: FollowTheMoney topic codes, e.g. sanction, sanction.linked, role.pep, role.rca, poi, wanted, crime, debarment, export.control.
